name: Rania Haddad
scenario_title: A Walk Around the Campus Gardens
action: Rania shifts the heavy satchel to her other shoulder and nods. "Alright," she says, "but only a quick one—I have a stack of essays and a deadline waiting. Lead the way." She falls into step beside Samir toward the campus gardens.
reason: Her initial impulse was to accept the walk, drawn by Samir's kindness and the prospect of jasmine and unhurried conversation. On reflection, she strengthened that impulse: she connected saying yes to the life she chose after her divorce and to the informal exchanges that once shaped her teaching. The essays and translation deadline remained a real cost, so she agreed to a quick walk and named the deadline aloud, accepting the connection without pretending the work would wait. Her history of repaying kindness and reluctance to take help surfaced, but the memory of lost invitations and her commitment to staying connected won out, producing an acceptance with a time limit that preserved her sense of responsibility.
